graph_diagnosis.summary: Search, cloud, and advertising segments provide a reusable consolidated-revenue framework.
weaknesses: Profitability and buybacks are indirect revenue evidence.

search_factors.why_search: Search is a core consolidated-revenue driver.
Video-ad weakness can restrain advertising revenue.
Macro ad conditions can affect multiple revenue segments.

checkpoints.mechanism: Search performance can lift consolidated revenue growth.
checkpoints.evidence_requirement: Verify search revenue and advertiser demand.

checkpoints.mechanism: Cloud strength can add to consolidated revenue momentum.
checkpoints.evidence_requirement: Check cloud revenue and profitability trends.

checkpoints.mechanism: Video-ad weakness can restrain consolidated growth.
Slower core-search growth can offset other segment strength.
checkpoints.evidence_requirement: Compare search growth with cloud contribution.

checkpoints.mechanism: Search, cloud, and advertising trends combine into revenue-growth acceleration.
checkpoints.evidence_requirement: Calculate sequential change in consolidated year-over-year revenue growth.
checkpoints.contradiction_signal: Segment mix does not reconcile to consolidated revenue.

causal_paths.generalized_mechanism: Search and cloud strength can improve consolidated revenue momentum.
Video-ad weakness can restrain consolidated growth.

alternative_hypotheses.hypothesis: A weak advertising market dominates company-specific segment resilience.
alternative_hypotheses.discriminating_evidence: Compare advertising indicators with search and video-ad revenue.

forecast_audit_questions: Does search demand corroborate advertising-market data?
Can cloud growth offset advertising weakness?
Do segment weights support consolidated momentum?
